text: Still not it. This is still showing a full highlight of the uv after doing a loop cut
resolution: Reported as 'loop cut still shows a full UV highlight' — resolved as not-a-bug: the studio's loop cut requires Apply (the confirm popup designed in req_0984-0990) for the cut to commit, after which the selection-scoped UV correctly shows the kept half-square. The user confirmed 'working as intended now.' The only divergence from Blockbench is the confirm step itself — Blockbench's loop cut is immediate (no Apply). Noted as a known difference the user accepted for now; can be made live (commit-on-change / drop the Apply button) later if exact parity is wanted. No code change needed; selection-scoping (req_1005) validated working.
